name: Giuseppe Pastore
features: olive skin, dark hair combed back, dark eyes, narrow studious face, neat moustache, slim build, measured unsmiling expression, soft leather helmet with round goggles pushed up on the brow, white linen overalls
bio: Engineer before he was ever a driver. Pastore worked on the supercharged Fiat 805 from 1922, testing the car at Monza long before he was allowed to race it, and was promoted to the works team in 1924 — the Targa Florio, then the French Grand Prix at Lyon, where a burst tyre put him into the bank on lap eleven. He went on to run Fiat's Lingotto works. Reads a car the way the men who built it do, and drives it accordingly.
